name: Fetal Brain Tissue Annotation and Segmentation Challenge
description: A challenge evaluating methods for annotation and segmentation of fetal brain tissue from medical imaging with a common dataset and metrics.
reputation: A specialized medical imaging challenge used in fetal neuroimage research with moderate adoption among academic groups working on prenatal MRI/US segmentation.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on medical image segmentation; datasets can be small and subject to inter-annotator variability; risk of dataset-specific overfitting.
